title: Armed ATM robbery and vehicle hijacking reported in Oshakati
summary: The Namibian reports that robbers fired shots, stole money from an ATM customer, and hijacked a vehicle in Oshakati on September 25. A September 29 follow-up reports the arrest of a person allegedly linked to the robbery. Allegations remain unproven; the reports do not establish a continuing threat.
